categories.main_business_segments: Beijing Yupont Electric Power Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in intelligent electric power products, including smart meters, electricity information collection terminals, fault indicators, and communication modules. The company also provides intelligent inspection services, information technology services, and energy storage business. Its products and services cover power generation, transmission, transformation, distribution, and dispatching sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies such as laser point cloud automatic classification, digital transmission line corridor technology, power data governance and application platforms, clock compensation calibration, wide current range design, modular embedded software platforms, and embedded hardware design. It employs automated intelligent production lines and smart testing equipment, with significant R&D investment in AI, digital twin platforms, UAV autonomous inspection, and energy storage technologies including liquid cooling and wind cooling battery packs.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include State Grid Corporation of China, China Southern Power Grid, and large power generation enterprises. The company serves the national new power system construction and digital grid construction markets, providing core equipment and services to power grid companies and central state-owned enterprises. Its products are widely used in power grids, photovoltaic, wind power, forestry, water conservancy, and other sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant market presence in regions such as East China, North China, Central China, South China, Southwest, Northeast, Northwest, and Southeast China. It has subsidiaries and operations in Beijing, Jiaxing, Guangdong, Wuhan, Inner Mongolia, and Hong Kong, and is expanding into international markets including Australia, Southeast Asia, and Central Asia.
categories.supply_chain_position: Yupont Electric Power operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the electric power supply chain, focusing on manufacturing intelligent electric power equipment and providing inspection and IT services. It is a core supplier to power grid companies, involved in product development, manufacturing, and after-sales services, as well as system integration and project implementation in energy storage and digital grid solutions.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in intelligent electric power products, AI-powered intelligent inspection, digital twin technology, and energy storage solutions. It emphasizes innovation in smart meters, UAV inspection systems, energy management systems, and modular energy storage in line with new power system construction and carbon neutrality goals. The company plans to deepen AI integration, expand product lines, and enhance manufacturing automation and digital transformation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of intelligent electric power products and energy storage equipment, provision of intelligent inspection and information technology services, and project-based contracts with power grid enterprises. The company also engages in agent-based sales for certain energy storage products, recognizing net commission income. Revenue recognition follows contract completion and customer acceptance.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Yupont Electric Power is a leading domestic player in intelligent electric power equipment and services, recognized as a core supplier to State Grid and Southern Power Grid. It holds a strong market position with advanced technology and comprehensive product lines. The company faces competition from numerous qualified enterprises in a fragmented market but maintains competitive advantages through early entry, integrated solutions, and strong customer relationships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 940 million, a 67.35% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 111 million, up 195.77%. The company has shown strong growth driven by increased orders from major power grid customers and expanded business segments. Total assets reached RMB 1.84 billion with a stable financial position and increased R&D investment accounting for 8.52% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Yupont Electric Power emphasizes advanced core technologies, high-precision and reliable intelligent electric power products, and integrated intelligent inspection solutions. Its products feature superior metering accuracy, multi-communication modes, low power consumption, and compliance with national standards. The company offers comprehensive lifecycle services, innovative AI and digital twin applications, and automated manufacturing, delivering high-quality, efficient, and customized solutions that support new power system and carbon neutrality initiatives.
